en.askTitle: Swap in your household size, city and budget, and get the week's meals and shopping list re-planned for you
en.runTitle: Two adults in Chicago on about $90 a week: seven days of meals, a shopping list by store section, and nutrition estimates

fields.label: Date, store and delivery
fields.value: Public prices from a mainstream US grocery chain's website, with the link and the date checked

fields.label: Diet, allergies, appetite or clinical targets
fields.value: Not vegetarian but meat only a few times a week, no nut allergies, no medical diet

fields.label: Equipment and storage
fields.placeholder: e.g. stove and oven, one fridge-freezer, no slow cooker

fields.label: Pantry quantities
fields.placeholder: e.g. oil, salt, rice and common spices already at home

fields.label: Prep and evening time
fields.value: About 30 minutes on weeknights, batch cooking on Sunday

en.template: Plan seven days of breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for {people} in {city}, shopping {shop} within {budget}. Use {diet}, {kitchen}, {pantry} and {time}. Give per-person and batch quantities, next-day leftovers, whole-package local prices with dated links, edible/drained yields and surplus. Include oil and snacks, traceable nutrition with raw/dry/cooked and brand limits, safe cooling/freezing/thawing and a price-rise check. Label old or failed price checks. Return an editable budget and phone-friendly cooking guide; do not buy, contact anyone, publish or submit.

phases.title: Check current Walmart prices item by item and look up the nutrition database
phases.note: Ten staples, plus eggs, dairy, chicken, frozen and fresh produce, each price tied to a product page and the time it was read
phases.judgment: Walmart's site defaults to a Sacramento store. It did not pass those off as Chicago prices: the delivery says outright that these are Sacramento public prices, not verified Chicago prices.

phases.title: Plan the seven days and recipes, then build the shopping list, nutrition sheet and phone page
phases.note: 13 recipes, two snacks a day, and a Sunday prep and freezer plan

phases.title: Check quantities, formulas and the phone page, then deliver
phases.note: A separate colleague recalculated from scratch without looking at the main result
phases.judgment: The reviewer did not copy the main result. It re-added every scheduled serving and the whole shopping list itself, and the totals agreed: 24 items come to $80.90, leaving $9.10 under the $90 budget, and all 563 spreadsheet formulas ran with no errors.

workers: Looked up ten dry and canned staples on Walmart's site (oats, brown rice, wholemeal bread, beans, olive oil and so on) and saved each product page and price as evidence
Priced eggs, dairy, chicken breast, frozen vegetables and fresh produce; when the 18-egg pack was out of stock it checked a 12-egg alternative
Independent check: re-added servings and shopping quantities, recalculated the workbook formulas, then opened the page at phone width and tried each part

zh.askTitle: 改成你家的人数、城市和预算，一周餐单和采购清单就按你的情况重排
zh.runTitle: 芝加哥两人每周约 $90：七天餐单、分区采购清单和营养估算

fields.label: 采购日期、门店和配送方式
fields.value: 查价当天美国大型连锁超市官网上的公开价格，附链接和查价日期

fields.label: 饮食、过敏、食量或临床目标
fields.value: 不吃素但每周只吃几次肉，无坚果过敏，非医疗用途

fields.label: 厨具和储存空间
fields.placeholder: 例如：灶台加烤箱，一台带冷冻室的冰箱，没有慢炖锅

fields.label: 家中食材数量
fields.placeholder: 例如：家里已有食用油、盐、大米和常用香料

fields.label: 备餐和晚间时间
fields.value: 工作日晚上约 30 分钟，周日可以批量备餐

zh.template: 请为{people}安排在{city}使用的七天早午晚餐和加餐，采购{shop}，预算{budget}。按{diet}、{kitchen}、{pantry}及{time}规划。列每人和整锅用量、次日剩餐、附日期和链接的当地整包装价格、可食及沥干出成率和余量。计入油与加餐，营养注明生干熟及品牌替代局限，给安全冷却冷冻解冻安排和涨价试算，标清旧价格或查价失败项。提供可编辑预算和手机烹饪指南；不要购买、联系、发布或提交。

phases.title: 逐样核对沃尔玛官网现价，查营养数据库
phases.note: 10 样主食，加上蛋奶、鸡肉、冷冻蔬菜和新鲜果蔬，每个价格都带商品页和查价时间
phases.judgment: 沃尔玛官网默认给的是萨克拉门托门店的价格。它没有把这些价当成芝加哥价，交付说明里直接写明：这是萨克拉门托的公开价格，不是芝加哥核实过的价格。

phases.title: 排七天餐单和食谱，做出采购清单、营养表和手机页
phases.note: 13 个食谱、每天两次加餐，以及周日备餐和冷冻安排

phases.title: 核对用量、公式和手机页，再交付
phases.note: 独立同事另起一遍计算，不看主流程的结果
phases.judgment: 复核同事没有照搬主流程的结果，自己把每顿饭的份量和整份采购清单重新加总了一遍，结果对得上：24 项合计 $80.90，比 $90 预算还剩 $9.10，工作簿 563 条公式零错误。

workers: 在沃尔玛官网查 10 样干货和罐头主食的价格（燕麦、糙米、全麦面包、豆类、橄榄油等），逐项存下商品页和价格证据
查蛋奶、鸡胸肉、冷冻蔬菜和新鲜果蔬的价格；18 枚装鸡蛋缺货，就补查了 12 枚装的鸡蛋
独立复核：自己重新加总份量和采购量，重算工作簿公式，再用手机宽度打开页面逐项点一遍
